map.由扭矩与角速度求旋转功率 使用指南: Rotational Power from Torque and Angular Velocity User Guide
map.旋转功率计算器，输入扭矩 τ 与角速度 ω 按 P=τ·ω 求旋转功率，用于旋转: The rotational power calculator takes torque tau and angular velocity omega and computes P = tau x omega, used to analyze rotational power.
map.P = τ·ω。 τ=10,ω=5 → 50 W。: P = tau * omega. With tau=10 and omega=5 -> 50 W.
map.输入扭矩 τ 与角速度 ω，求旋转功率。: Enter torque tau and angular velocity omega to get rotational power.
map.电机功率：录入输出扭矩与转速，求旋转功率，辅助电机选型。: Motor power: enter output torque and speed to get rotational power, assisting motor selection.
map.传动系统：对齿轮/皮带录入扭矩与角速度，求传递功率。: Drive system: enter torque and angular velocity for gears or belts to get the transmitted power.
map.教学演示：演示同扭矩下转速越高功率越大。: Teaching demo: shows that at the same torque, higher speed means higher power.
map.：示例：τ=10 N·m、ω=100 rad/s，P=10×100=1000 W: Example: with tau = 10 N*m and omega = 100 rad/s, P = 10 x 100 = 1000 W = 1 kW.

map.先换算 ω=2π·rpm/60（rad/s），再代入 P=τω。结果按标准力学公: First convert omega = 2pi x rpm/60 (rad/s), then substitute into P = tau x omega.
